g.text: Sequence Diagram - WEB06 Activate a Kitchen Configuration (single consistent operation, confirmation and viewer reload)
Current state: KCF-00001 "Compact kitchen" = ACTIVE, KCF-00002 "Extended line" = INACTIVE.
Invariant (BR 8): at most one ACTIVE row - enforced by the service AND by the
partial unique index kitchen_configurations_single_active ON (status) WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'.
Order inside the transaction (same as KitchenConfigurationService.activateConfiguration in the
class diagram): lock -> load target FOR UPDATE -> re-validate (catalogue AND files)
-> already ACTIVE? return -> status updates. A missing file is a 422 BEFORE any status change.
will become inactive and the viewer will use
activation waits here until this transaction
ends and then reads the committed state.
SELECT ... FROM kitchen_configurations WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
FOR UPDATE: a concurrent DELETE or PUT of
SELECT ... FROM kitchen_assets WHERE id = ANY($1::varchar[])
[each referenced asset found in the catalogue]
[B1) Invalid: an asset file is missing (ASSET_FILE_MISSING) or the content
no longer satisfies the rules - whether the target is ACTIVE or INACTIVE]
No status has been changed yet:
never reached. An already ACTIVE target
with a missing file is reported (422),
result { active: target, previous: null } (idempotent, no write)
WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND id <> $1 RETURNING id
[unique violation 23505 on the partial index (should not happen with the lock)]
throw AppError("Another activation was in progress. Reload and try again.", 409)
Both status changes become visible together:
GET /active sees KCF-00001 or KCF-00002, never
both and never none (once one was active).
nothing changed - KCF-00001 is still ACTIVE
list() (re-read the saved state, BR 14 WEB01)
"'Extended line' (KCF-00002) is now the active configuration"

"This configuration can no longer be activated" + issues
